statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. Call a partition of nums into m contiguous subarrays valid if the subarrays are ordered left to right, the first starts at index 0, the last ends at index len(nums)-1, consecutive subarrays are adjacent (each next subarray starts one index after the previous ends), each subarray is nonempty, and for every i with 0 <= i < m the bitwise AND of the elements of the i-th subarray equals andValues[i]. If at least one valid partition exists, then r equals the minimum, over all valid partitions, of the sum of the last elements of the m subarrays. If no valid partition exists, then r = -1.
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail, overflow, or panic.
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, either r = -1, or m <= r <= sum_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[i].
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if the bitwise AND of all elements of nums equals andValues[0], then r = nums[len(nums)-1]; otherwise r = -1.
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); m = 1; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} nums[i] if nums[i] = andValues[i] for every i with 0 <= i < n; otherwise r = -1.
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); m = len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, there exists a valid partition of nums into m contiguous subarrays (ordered left to right, first starting at index 0, last ending at index len(nums)-1, consecutive and nonempty, with the i-th subarray bitwise AND equal to andValues[i]) whose sum of last elements is exactly r.
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, for every valid partition of nums into m contiguous subarrays (ordered left to right, first starting at index 0, last ending at index len(nums)-1, consecutive and nonempty, with the i-th subarray bitwise AND equal to andValues[i]) with sum of last elements S, we have r <= S.
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r = -1, there does not exist any valid partition of nums into m contiguous subarrays (ordered left to right, first starting at index 0, last ending at index len(nums)-1, consecutive and nonempty, with the i-th subarray bitwise AND equal to andValues[i]).
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, r >= nums[len(nums)-1] + (m - 1).
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, (andValues[0] & nums[0]) = andValues[0] and (andValues[m-1] & nums[len(nums)-1]) = andValues[m-1], where & denotes bitwise AND.
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, there exist m integers k_0 < k_1 < ... < k_{m-1} with 0 <= k_0 and k_{m-1} = len(nums)-1 such that r = sum_{i=0}^{m-1} nums[k_i].
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, the bitwise AND of all elements of nums equals the bitwise AND of all elements of andValues, i.e., nums[0] & ... & nums[n-1] = andValues[0] & ... & andValues[m-1].
preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.

preconditions: len(nums) = n with 1 <= n <= 10^4; len(andValues) = m with 1 <= m <= min(n, 10); for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] < 10^5; for every j with 0 <= j < m, 0 <= andValues[j] < 10^5.
